user.title: iSpindel → Grainfather
user.description: Home Assistant will receive readings from the iSpindel and relay them to your Grainfather brew session.

data.name: Name
data.stale_minutes: Skip forwarding if the last reading is older than

data_description.grainfather_url: From the Grainfather app: Equipment → your iSpindel → View instructions. Copy the whole server address and path shown there.
data_description.input_unit: Float the device in plain water: a reading near 1.000 means SG, a reading near 0 (including small negatives like -0.44) means Plato.
data_description.output_unit: Match your Grainfather session. Usually SG. If your device reports Plato and Grainfather expects SG, these two differ — that is normal.
data_description.stale_minutes: Prevents a dead device from drawing a flat line across your brew session. Must exceed the forwarding interval.
data_description.webhook_id: Leave blank to generate one. Set it to reuse a URL your iSpindel is already configured with, so you do not have to put the device back into config mode.

webhook.title: Point the iSpindel at Home Assistant
webhook.description:
In the iSpindel configuration portal, set:

- **Service Type**: HTTP
- **Server Address**: `{host}`
- **Server Port**: `{port}`
- **Server URL**: `{path}`

Full URL: `{url}`

The webhook only accepts requests from your local network. Submit to finish.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://
error.stale_too_short: This must be longer than the forwarding interval, or nothing will ever be sent
error.invalid_webhook_id: Use 8-255 characters: letters, numbers, hyphen or underscore only
